messages:
ellen: Noticed a confusing UX in the Playground run history today. If a tool call fails we get a red toast but the row remains collapsed and shows 'No output'. Users think it succeeded. Repro: call `translate` with a schema missing `target_lang`. Screenshot: https://rwd/short/errshot :frowning: raj: Oof. That's bad. We should show a 1-line inline error summary in the row itself, plus a small affordance to expand a compact preview. Idea: 'Tool failed: missing field `target_lang`' with an error badge and a chevron. sam: Strong +1 for inline. Accessibility by default: the preview must be keyboard focusable and announced. Proposed pattern: ``
ToolError: missing field ...
`` Focus management: when opening focus should move into the region and screen reader should read the short summary. avery: Copy change: replace 'No output' with 'No tool output — expand to view error or logs'. Short and instructive. Also prefer 'Tool failed — expand for details' as the inline prefix. mika: For triage speed, include the first ~160 chars of the error/stack inline and a small copy icon. If it's a retried call show a retry count badge. design-bot: Uploaded quick mock: https://rwd/fig/inline-err-v2. I used a 10px red left border, 12px truncated text and a subtle error icon so row height doesn't jump. Using an explicit 'Show' button over hover. raj: Love the 'Show' button — no hover-only reliance. Two tradeoffs: 1) keep rows short for dense logs, 2) ensure contrast/focus is accessible. sam: Keyboard shortcuts proposal: with a row focused, press 'e' to toggle preview; Shift+E toggles all previews for that invocation. Add to ax-guide. avery: Alternative microcopy options for the inline label: - 'Tool failed — expand for details' - 'Error from tool — open details' - 'Tool error — see logs' My pick: 'Tool failed — expand for details'. mika: Edge: private deployments may not surface logs. In those cases the preview should display 'Logs unavailable for this deployment' rather than nothing. ellen: Also consider long JSON diffs/stack traces. Render a single-line truncated code block with a 'Show full' link to open the invocation inspector, and a copy button. design-bot: Accessibility nit: chevron contrast at current token is 3.9:1. I'll increase to 4.5:1 and verify keyboard focus ring is 2px min. raj: I'll spike the inline preview component and the aria pattern (link to issue INFER-4219). ETA Wed. sam: I'll write the keyboard shortcut spec and add examples in the accessibility guide by Tues. avery: I'll prototype the microcopy tests with support team and update the language matrix. mika: I'll draft the retry/status badge states and include timestamps and counts. ops-bot: CI: playground-service/nightly #278 passed :white_check_mark: ellen: Thanks — let's try to land an MVP that shows 1-line error + inline preview + keyboard toggle. Targeting a dev PR by next Thursday. Ping me if blocked. :thumbsup:
